subject_template: Fluxio Pilot A: alerta de respaldo {code}
body_template: Evento: {code}. Fecha UTC: {timestamp}. ID operativo: {backup_id}. Revisar el estado del respaldo y registrar respuesta. No incluye datos de atletas ni enlaces privados.
success_policy: provider acceptance is not inbox receipt; Gaston must confirm receipt
delivery_failure_policy: persist redacted failure independently; do not claim notification delivered
anti_spam_policy_pending: confirm deduplication, reminder interval and escalation before activation
alternative_transport: SMTP TLS using API key as password; integration not implemented
idempotency_policy: persist stable event/request ID; same event and payload reuse key; uncertain send no blind resend; provider retention window must be respected
